Login and logout are handled by Spring Security, configured in SecurityConfig; it loads users through AppUserDetailsService.<br>• AppUserDetailsService blocks unverified (US-03) and banned (US-22) accounts only after the password matches.<br>• Signup and resend always return the same MessageResponse, whether or not the account exists (AC-01).<br>• Raw verification tokens are only ever emailed; only their hash is stored (AC-14).<br>• Login rate limiting is done by RateLimitFilter (see class-inventory.md) (AC-02).<br>• Account deletion (US-23) lives in UserController / UserService, shown with div.div:
Constraints
• reviews: UNIQUE (author_id, course_id) · CHECK score BETWEEN 1 AND 5
• reports: UNIQUE (reporter_id, review_id)
• users: CHECK role IN ('STUDENT','ADMIN') · CHECK status IN ('ACTIVE','BANNED')
• reports: CHECK reason / status match the Java enums
• catalog_requests: CHECK type IN ('COURSE','PROFESSOR'); course requests need course_code and title, professor requests need professor_name
• courses: CHECK code ~ '^[A-Z]{4}-[0-9]{3}$'
• admin_action_logs: app's database user has INSERT and SELECT only (append-only)
